fact: In 2025 the SIGE 2.0 platform was operational and available to the whole network of sector and regional statisticians and to DGEPASE, with 92 regional and sector statisticians and education inspectors trained to use it and 328 school directors and deputy directors trained to collect education data, under FEC's PESIDE project; the users named are statisticians, not schools.
title: Relatório de Atividades FEC 2025
